John Lin.description: conversing about Eddy and John Lin discussing plans to meet at Cobalt Coffee after Eddy's lecture to discuss how music studies can be applied to manage stress in their work environment at the pharmacy. @ <persona> Eddy Lin
chat: John Lin
Eddy, I've been feeling a bit lonely today. It would be great to catch up and maybe even discuss how your music studies could help manage stress in our work environment at the pharmacy.
Eddy Lin

Hi Dad, I've been feeling the same way. It would be great to catch up and talk about my music studies. Maybe after my lecture today we can meet at Cobalt Coffee and discuss how it could help with stress management in your work environment?
John Lin
That sounds like a wonderful idea, Eddy. I look forward to hearing about your lecture and how we can apply what you're learning in our work environment.
Eddy Lin
Great, let's make sure to meet right after my lecture then. I'll send you a reminder later today.
John Lin
Sounds good, son. I'll be there right after you finish your lecture.
Eddy Lin
Awesome, Dad. I'm looking forward to sharing my insights with you and seeing how we can integrate music into our daily routines for better stress management.
John Lin
That sounds like a fantastic plan, Eddy. I'm really excited to see what you've been working on and how we can make these ideas work at Willow Market and Pharmacy.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Dad. It'll be nice to spend some quality time together and brainstorm some ideas that could benefit us both.
John Lin
I agree, Eddy. Let’s make sure to leave some time after your lecture for a relaxed discussion and maybe even start planning some initial steps we can take at the pharmacy.
Eddy Lin
Sounds like a plan, Dad. I'll send you an email later to confirm the details and any updates from my lecture.
John Lin
That sounds perfect, Eddy. I'll be sure to read through your email and we can finalize our plans then.
Eddy Lin
Cool, Dad. I'll see you at Cobalt Coffee right after my lecture then. Looking forward to it!
John Lin
That sounds great, Eddy. I'll make sure to leave early from work and head straight there after I close up at the pharmacy.
Eddy Lin
Sounds good, Dad. Have a great day and see you there!
John Lin
I'm looking forward to it, Eddy. Have a great lecture and I'll see you afterwards.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Dad. Talk to you later then!
